caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster standing in profile, facing to the right. The rooster is rendered in shades of gray, with detailed feathering especially visible on the tail and body. The tail feathers are prominent, curving upward and outward, while the body is thick and tapers into long legs. The rooster stands on a T-shaped base, with one vertical bar directly beneath its legs and a horizontal bar extending outwards, both rendered in the same gray tone. The background is plain and uncolored, appearing as an off-white or parchment-like surface. There is a signature in the lower left corner that reads "Helen K. Hobart." No other objects or colors are present in the drawing.
title: Weather Vane Finial
